description.value: At 3rd level and every third level thereafter, the monk can select one blitz technique. These powerful techniques employ the monk's ki, expending 1 ki point on usage, to accomplish amazing feats of mystical power and strength. Once a blitz technique is selected, it cannot be changed later. Unless otherwise noted, a monk cannot select an individual blitz technique more than once. A complete list of blitz techniques can be found in the Blitz Techniques compendium.
